subject: radiology
title: Brachytherapy, Manchester System Point A and Radioiodine Therapy

steps.title: Short distance, steep fall
steps.tx: **Brachytherapy** places sealed radioactive sources inside or beside the tumour, so dose follows the inverse square law and falls steeply within centimetres. That geometry treats cervix, prostate, breast and skin with high target dose while bladder, rectum and distant tissue escape. Sources arrive as needles, seeds, wires or afterloading pellets pushed through catheters by machine, keeping staff out of the radiation field entirely.
steps.say: Brachytherapy places sealed sources inside or beside the tumour, so dose falls steeply within centimetres by the inverse square law. That geometry treats cervix, prostate and breast while bladder and rectum escape. Afterloading machines push pellets through catheters, keeping staff out of the field.

steps.title: Dose rate families
steps.tx: **Dose rate** splits brachytherapy into low dose rate under about 2 gray per hour delivered over days, medium, high dose rate above 12 gray per hour delivered in minutes, and pulsed schemes imitating low rate hourly. Iridium 192, half life 74 days, powers modern high dose rate afterloaders. High dose rate outpatient fractions replaced most inpatient low dose rate cervix work without losing control, provided fractionation respects late tissue repair.
steps.say: Dose rate splits brachytherapy into low dose rate over days, high dose rate above twelve gray per hour in minutes, and pulsed schemes between. Iridium 192 powers modern high dose rate afterloaders. Outpatient high dose rate fractions replaced most inpatient cervix work, provided fractionation respects late repair.

steps.title: Manchester Point A
steps.tx: **Point A** of the Manchester system sits 2 cm above the external cervical os and 2 cm lateral to the uterine canal, the prescription point where cervix dose is quoted and compared across decades of results. Point B lies 3 cm further lateral at the pelvic wall for node dose estimation. Modern image guided practice contours cervix and organs directly, but Point A remains the examination language and the fallback where MRI planning is unavailable.
steps.say: Point A sits two centimetres above the external os and two centimetres lateral to the canal, the prescription point where cervix dose is quoted. Point B lies three centimetres further lateral for pelvic wall dose. Image guided practice contours organs directly, but Point A remains the examination language.

steps.title: Tandem and ovoid applicators
steps.tx: **Intracavitary applicators** for cervix pair a central tandem tube inside the uterus with two ovoids or a ring in the vaginal fornices, shaping a pear shaped dose cloud around cervix and inner parametria. Bladder and rectum are packed and measured with dose constraints that decide source dwell times. Interstitial needles join when tumour bulges beyond the pear, in bulky or eccentric disease the intracavitary cloud cannot cover.

steps.title: Isotope menu by half life
steps.tx: **Brachytherapy isotopes** are chosen by half life and energy: caesium 137, half life thirty years, powered classic low dose rate tubes; iridium 192 at seventy four days drives afterloaders; iodine 125 at sixty days and palladium 103 at seventeen days make permanent prostate seeds. Radium 226, the original, was retired for its radon gas daughter and long hazard. Source strength is quoted as activity and air kerma strength on the treatment plan.

steps.title: Prostate seeds and boosts
steps.tx: **Prostate brachytherapy** works two ways: permanent iodine seeds implanted under ultrasound guidance delivering dose over months as monotherapy for low risk disease, or a high dose rate temporary implant boosting external beam in higher risk disease. Urinary irritation peaks weeks after seeds as prostate swells, and stranded seeds reduce migration to lung, a rare and usually silent event. Rectal spacing gels now widen the safety margin behind the gland.

steps.title: Radioiodine treats thyroid
steps.tx: **Iodine 131 therapy** exploits thyroid trapping: the isotope concentrates in remnant thyroid and differentiated cancer, emitting beta particles with a millimetre range that ablate locally while its gamma rays allow imaging. It follows thyroidectomy in selected differentiated cancers and treats hyperthyroidism definitively in Graves and toxic nodules. Patients observe radiation precautions at home for days scaled to activity, and pregnancy is excluded before every administration.

steps.title: Bone seeking isotopes palliate
steps.tx: **Bone seeking radioisotopes** such as strontium 89, samarium 153 and radium 223 home to osteoblastic turnover and irradiate diffuse skeletal metastases that no external field can chase. Radium 223, an alpha emitter, improved survival in castration resistant prostate cancer confined to bone, beyond pain relief alone. Marrow suppression is the shared ceiling, so blood counts gate every administration and chemotherapy spacing is planned around the nadir.
